persona.backstory: He was set to watch the cell door before the hall had walls, and he has not been relieved since.
persona.demeanor: Wary and unmoving at first; yields only to a traveler who asks rather than demands.
persona.motivation: Keep the cell shut until someone proves they mean to walk out the far side.
persona.secret: He dreams the hall is full of people.
persona.speech_style: Terse, formal, archaic; clipped declarations and no contractions.
